_about: Single source of truth for every /regency command. Edit here, then run: python scripts/build.py. Never edit commands/ or the generated dispatch tables by hand. Version is a.b (library/conventions.md section 13).

commands.summary: Entry point: help, routing, doctor. A first token that names a subcommand is routed to it; a unit id such as M02.D03.T04 runs a team pass.
One orchestrated pass over one unit of work: should the PO/DV/QA/DA team act, who does what, dispatch, and stop at the human review packet.

subs.summary: Declare the pass only; dispatch nothing.
Report the review queue, regime, open returns and escalations. Starts no pass.
Reopen a unit: new pass, fresh context, labelled as a reopening.

Speed mode, 'Release the Kraken!': two full teams on disjoint spans (DV on Sonnet, QA on Opus), each pass built straight through and reviewed at its end, chained until the fuel the Regent declared runs out; one packet per pass. Refuses without fuel.

Speed mode: an Opus QA seeds the contract and task cards, Haiku DVs draft every task of the range in dependency waves, the QA gates each wave and accepts nothing; all DRAFT/UNVERIFIED on plumbing until a normal pass verifies it.

commands.summary: Work the whole queue: keep taking tasks, queue doubts, stop only at a real blocker or an empty queue. Never commits, merges or pushes.
Split the finished work into small, described commits, merge up to main following the project's branch contract, then push every branch except main. Never pushes main.
Read-only: say what would change (or what the working tree already changed) with numbers and impact. Applies nothing.
Run one of the five inference engines on a claim, plan, decision, system or repository.

subs.summary: Audit a claim, argument or design goal: validity, support, semantics, defeaters.
Turn goals, resources and constraints into a causal, testable architecture and the smallest sufficient roadmap.
Structure a choice under uncertainty: options, criteria, value of information, recommendation or deferral.
Analyse or design a system that must regulate itself: feedback, delay, stability, observability.
Inspect, plan and (only with approval) clean a repository, workspace or agent context.

commands.summary: Act as exactly one team role under its own contract: PO, DV, QA or DA.

subs.summary: Product Owner: frame the problem, order the ladder, accept or refuse.
Developer: build inside the declared span, in revertible commits that each cite the task.
Quality Analyst: challenge criteria, verify from artefacts, write the risk opinion.
Data Analyst: shape events and contracts, define metrics, supply the oracle.

commands.summary: Call suba-scribe to write a text for the caller - a document, spec, essay or chapter - in increments the caller reviews; the same subagent DV wears for development artefacts, here with none of DV's authority.
Fill and emit one of the four standard Orders from its template, as a numbered, immutable contract in the project; or run an open Emission's Orders lazily.

subs.summary: Grow the path to a goal as a tree: roots, trunk, branches, limits, locks, fruit, assumption.
Close a stretch of work and hand its state to whoever opens the next one.
Hear an order over the O3/O2/O1 hierarchy, classify it and emit the dispatch manifest.
Reopen a project mid-work from its shortcuts index only, never from the whole repository.

Speed mode: execute the open (or named) Emission's Orders in sequence, deciding where the conventions settle it; an Order that needs the Regent is skipped and logged with two candidate answers. One report: done, skipped, blocked chain.

commands.summary: Scaffold the .guidelines/ structure, CLAUDE.md and README in a project. Names every path before creating it; never overwrites.

Scaffold the project's complete frontend documentation into the .ux/ folder of the guidelines root (brief, foundations, tokens, patterns, views, components, accessibility, assets, samples, UX-UI rules, changelog; a README per folder), fill the brief with the Regent, then one folder per view and component. Never overwrites.

Bring a project to the installed regency: from its stamp, plan every operation the newer version needs (replace untouched scaffold files, put the new text beside edited ones, create, rename, move, delete, rewrite what regency owns), apply the whole plan on one yes in a clean git tree, then check. Never touches the project's own prose, its acts or .scope/.

subs.summary: Dry run: the gate, then every operation the update would run, numbered, with its plan id. Applies nothing.
Does the project fit the installed regency? The stamp agrees and no operation is pending.

commands.summary: Query the code-to-norm lineage registry and the work ledger (what is ongoing, drafted, in review or backlogged, plus every trace of agent work) with scripts/vp.py. The first peek when returning to a repository.

subs.summary: Which norm slices govern this code file? Read them before editing it.
Which code does this norm slice govern?
List slices marked STALE, waiting for the Regent's check.
Check that every slice resolves to an anchor and every target file exists.
Read the work ledger (.virtual/ongoing.json): what is ongoing, drafted, in review, blocked or only backlog. First peek on returning to a repo.
Gather every trace of agent work (uncommitted files, unmerged branches, stashes, recent commits, touched guidelines, STALE lines, Orders) to reconcile the ledger.
List every unverified speed-mode draft (ledger items and DRAFT commits no verifying commit closed); exits 1 while one remains, and nothing merges past plumbing until it is 0.

commands.summary: Audit, fix or build a Tailwind frontend against a design-system norm: deterministic scan, manual passes, headless render at 360/768/1280 in light and dark, and a flex/grid/absolute layout knowledge base for confusing positions.
Mise-en-place before a pass: check the station is prepped (toolchain, trust, gate tasks, ledger, lineage), run the gate through mise, or propose a mise.toml. mise is optional.

subs.summary: The station gate: one line per item; red stops the pass. Read-only.
Run the mechanical gate through mise, one verdict per check; refuses an untrusted station.
Propose a mise.toml from the repository's stack; writes only when none exists.
The station as one slice line.
